meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求添加 Microsoft Teams 集成时，Claude 会按步骤复制 Teams 适配器、注册并安装固定版本依赖，随后引导用户完成 Teams CLI 登录、创建机器人、写入 .env 凭证、设置图标并确认接线目标，让聊天能接入 Teams。
howto.when: 当用户要求将 Microsoft Teams 频道集成到应用中，或需要配置 Teams 聊天时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Microsoft Teams 频道集成。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行 Teams 设置流程。

say.text: 为我的应用配置 Teams 聊天支持。
给 NanoClaw 加上 Teams 机器人。
say.note: 会引导完成创建和接线。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to add Microsoft Teams integration, Claude copies the Teams adapter, registers it, installs pinned dependency, then guides through Teams CLI login, bot creation, writing credentials to .env, setting icons, and confirming the wiring target, enabling chat to connect to Teams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests adding Microsoft Teams channel integration to the app or configuring Teams chat support.

say_en.text: Please add Microsoft Teams channel integration.
say_en.note: Claude will start the Teams setup process.

say_en.text: Configure Teams chat support for my app.
say_en.note: You'll need a Microsoft 365 account and an HTTPS endpoint.

say_en.text: Add a Teams bot to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It will guide through creation and wiring.
